newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent spot prices firm on turnarounds.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent spot prices firm on turnarounds.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel prices firmed across the board on Tuesday, fueled by talk of turnarounds at key refineries in the region, traders said.

Texaco was scheduled over the weekend to take unspecified units at its 94,600 barrel per day El Dorado, Kansas refinery down for maintenance, traders said. Texaco officials were not immediately available for comment.
Conoco, National Cooperative Refinery Association and Farmland Industries Inc also have units down this week at their Midwest refineries, traders said.
"The El Dorado turnaround has had some impact in the Group this morning," one Kansas City, Mo., trader said.

Group Three unleaded gasoline firmed to deals heard done 0.80 cent a gallon under the print for prompt October deliveries, with later deliveries talked 1.75/1.50 cents under the print and premium firming to 2.50 cents higher.
Group Three low sulphur also moved higher, with prompt October deliveries talked 0.25/0.50 cent over the print and later deliveries 0.25 cent under to even with NYMEX November heating oil.
High sulphur diesel was talked 1.75/2.0 cents under the print in Group Three and Chicago.
Chicago unleaded remained 2.0/1.75 cents under the print for prompt October deliveries and 2.25/2.0 cents under for later deliveries, with premium 3.0 cents higher, traders said.
